'''Garrett Heilman''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[2000 Nevada State Championship]] on 8 April 2000 with unknown type (Obi-Wan deck), according to Danny Rider's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d491">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-04-09-las-vegas-nv-4-8-00-state-tournamentd491/ las-vegas-nv-4-8-00-state-tournament], DeckTech (Danny "Skuff D" Rider, 9 April 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-04-09-las-vegas-nv-4-8-00-state-tournamentd491/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
